newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura confirms prosecutors' raid on main office.
newsitem.headline: Nomura confirms prosecutors' raid on main office.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd confirmed on Thursday that Tokyo prosecutors were raiding its headquarters as part of an investigation into suspected illegal payoffs.
A Nomura spokesman said the raid was still in progress.

Earlier this week Japan's securities watchdog asked prosecutors to press a criminal case against Nomura and three former executives in a scandal over payments to "sokaiya" racketeers. The three ex-officials were arrested by prosecutors on Wednesday on suspicion of violating Japan's securities exchange law and its commercial code.
